An owner converting an existing **upper-upscale** hotel in the Caribbean and Latin America should primarily look at brands that are already active in the region and positioned for **upscale/upper-upscale conversions**, especially **Marriott**, **Westin**, **Sheraton**, **Renaissance**, **Autograph Collection**, **The Luxury Collection**, **Hilton**, **Curio Collection**, **Embassy Suites**, **Hyatt Regency**, **Hyatt Centric**, **Kimpton**, **InterContinental**, **Six Senses**, **voco**, **Crowne Plaza**, **Radisson Blu**, and **Wyndham**. [3][4][7][10][13][14][15][17]

The strongest regionally relevant options depend on whether the asset is best suited to a **hard brand** or a **soft brand/collection** conversion:
- **Marriott** is especially active in the Caribbean and Latin America, including **Westin**, **Sheraton**, **Renaissance**, **Autograph Collection**, **Delta by Marriott**, and **The Luxury Collection**. [3][4][14][16]
- **IHG** has been emphasizing **conversions** in the upscale and upper-upscale space, with brands such as **InterContinental**, **Kimpton**, **Regent**, **Six Senses**, **Hotel Indigo**, and **Crowne Plaza**. [8][13][15]
- **Hyatt** upper-upscale options cited in the market include **Hyatt Regency**, **Hyatt Centric**, and **JdV by Hyatt**. [9][17]
- **Hilton** brands commonly associated with this tier include **Hilton Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection**, **Embassy Suites**, and **Signia by Hilton**. [3][9][12]
- **Choice/Radisson** and **Wyndham** also appear in upper-upscale discussions, notably **Radisson Blu**, **Wyndham**, and **Dolce**. [6][10][11]

If the owner wants the shortest shortlist for a conversion mandate in this region, the most plausible candidates are **Marriott’s soft brands and legacy full-service flags**, **IHG conversion-friendly brands**, and **Hyatt Regency/Hyatt Centric** for premium urban or resort repositioning. [4][8][13][14][15]

An owner converting an existing **upper-upscale** hotel in the Caribbean and Latin America should primarily look at brands that are already active in the region and positioned for **upscale/upper-upscale conversions**, especially **Marriott**, **Westin**, **Sheraton**, **Renaissance**, **Autograph Collection**, **The Luxury Collection**, **Hilton**, **Curio Collection**, **Embassy Suites**, **Hyatt Regency**, **Hyatt Centric**, **Kimpton**, **InterContinental**, **Six Senses**, **voco**, **Crowne Plaza**, **Radisson Blu**, and **Wyndham**. [3][4][7][10][13][14][15][17]

The strongest regionally relevant options depend on whether the asset is best suited to a **hard brand** or a **soft brand/collection** conversion:
- **Marriott** is especially active in the Caribbean and Latin America, including **Westin**, **Sheraton**, **Renaissance**, **Autograph Collection**, **Delta by Marriott**, and **The Luxury Collection**. [3][4][14][16]
- **IHG** has been emphasizing **conversions** in the upscale and upper-upscale space, with brands such as **InterContinental**, **Kimpton**, **Regent**, **Six Senses**, **Hotel Indigo**, and **Crowne Plaza**. [8][13][15]
- **Hyatt** upper-upscale options cited in the market include **Hyatt Regency**, **Hyatt Centric**, and **JdV by Hyatt**. [9][17]
- **Hilton** brands commonly associated with this tier include **Hilton Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection**, **Embassy Suites**, and **Signia by Hilton**. [3][9][12]
- **Choice/Radisson** and **Wyndham** also appear in upper-upscale discussions, notably **Radisson Blu**, **Wyndham**, and **Dolce**. [6][10][11]

If the owner wants the shortest shortlist for a conversion mandate in this region, the most plausible candidates are **Marriott’s soft brands and legacy full-service flags**, **IHG conversion-friendly brands**, and **Hyatt Regency/Hyatt Centric** for premium urban or resort repositioning. [4][8][13][14][15]

message.content:
An owner converting an existing **upper-upscale** hotel in the Caribbean and Latin America should primarily look at brands that are already active in the region and positioned for **upscale/upper-upscale conversions**, especially **Marriott**, **Westin**, **Sheraton**, **Renaissance**, **Autograph Collection**, **The Luxury Collection**, **Hilton**, **Curio Collection**, **Embassy Suites**, **Hyatt Regency**, **Hyatt Centric**, **Kimpton**, **InterContinental**, **Six Senses**, **voco**, **Crowne Plaza**, **Radisson Blu**, and **Wyndham**. [3][4][7][10][13][14][15][17]

The strongest regionally relevant options depend on whether the asset is best suited to a **hard brand** or a **soft brand/collection** conversion:
- **Marriott** is especially active in the Caribbean and Latin America, including **Westin**, **Sheraton**, **Renaissance**, **Autograph Collection**, **Delta by Marriott**, and **The Luxury Collection**. [3][4][14][16]
- **IHG** has been emphasizing **conversions** in the upscale and upper-upscale space, with brands such as **InterContinental**, **Kimpton**, **Regent**, **Six Senses**, **Hotel Indigo**, and **Crowne Plaza**. [8][13][15]
- **Hyatt** upper-upscale options cited in the market include **Hyatt Regency**, **Hyatt Centric**, and **JdV by Hyatt**. [9][17]
- **Hilton** brands commonly associated with this tier include **Hilton Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection**, **Embassy Suites**, and **Signia by Hilton**. [3][9][12]
- **Choice/Radisson** and **Wyndham** also appear in upper-upscale discussions, notably **Radisson Blu**, **Wyndham**, and **Dolce**. [6][10][11]

If the owner wants the shortest shortlist for a conversion mandate in this region, the most plausible candidates are **Marriott’s soft brands and legacy full-service flags**, **IHG conversion-friendly brands**, and **Hyatt Regency/Hyatt Centric** for premium urban or resort repositioning. [4][8][13][14][15]

If you want, I can turn this into a **brand-by-brand conversion shortlist** by asset type: **resort, city hotel, all-inclusive, or mixed-use**.
